name: chime
description: Most of these APIs are no longer supported and will not be updated.

subcommands.name: associate-phone-number-with-user
subcommands.description: Associates a phone number with the specified Amazon Chime user.

subcommands.name: associate-signin-delegate-groups-with-account
subcommands.description: Associates the specified sign-in delegate groups with the specified Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: batch-create-room-membership
subcommands.description: Adds up to 50 members to a chat room in an Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-phone-number
subcommands.description: Moves phone numbers into the Deletion queue.

subcommands.name: batch-suspend-user
subcommands.description: Suspends up to 50 users from a Team or EnterpriseLWA Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: batch-unsuspend-user
subcommands.description: Removes the suspension from up to 50 previously suspended users for the specified Amazon Chime EnterpriseLWA account.

subcommands.name: batch-update-phone-number
subcommands.description: Updates phone number product types or calling names.

subcommands.name: batch-update-user
subcommands.description: Updates user details within the UpdateUserRequestItem object for up to 20 users for the specified Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: create-account
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Chime account under the administrator's AWS account.

subcommands.name: create-bot
subcommands.description: Creates a bot for an Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: create-meeting-dial-out
subcommands.description: Uses the join token and call metadata in a meeting request (From number, To number, and so forth) to initiate an outbound call to a public switched telephone network (PSTN) and join them into a Chime meeting.

subcommands.name: create-phone-number-order
subcommands.description: Creates an order for phone numbers to be provisioned.

subcommands.name: create-room
subcommands.description: Creates a chat room for the specified Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: create-room-membership
subcommands.description: Adds a member to a chat room in an Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: create-user
subcommands.description: Creates a user under the specified Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: delete-account
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: delete-events-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the events configuration that allows a bot to receive outgoing events.

subcommands.name: delete-phone-number
subcommands.description: Moves the specified phone number into the Deletion queue.

subcommands.name: delete-room
subcommands.description: Deletes a chat room in an Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: delete-room-membership
subcommands.description: Removes a member from a chat room in an Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: disassociate-phone-number-from-user
subcommands.description: Disassociates the primary provisioned phone number from the specified Amazon Chime user.

subcommands.name: disassociate-signin-delegate-groups-from-account
subcommands.description: Disassociates the specified sign-in delegate groups from the specified Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: get-account
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for the specified Amazon Chime account, such as account type and supported licenses.

subcommands.name: get-account-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves account settings for the specified Amazon Chime account ID, such as remote control and dialout settings.

subcommands.name: get-bot
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for the specified bot, such as bot email address, bot type, status, and display name.

subcommands.name: get-events-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets details for an events configuration that allows a bot to receive outgoing events, such as an HTTPS endpoint or Lambda function ARN.

subcommands.name: get-global-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves global settings for the administrator's AWS account, such as Amazon Chime Business Calling and Amazon Chime Voice Connector settings.

subcommands.name: get-phone-number
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for the specified phone number ID, such as associations, capabilities, and product type.

subcommands.name: get-phone-number-order
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for the specified phone number order, such as the order creation timestamp, phone numbers in E.164 format, product type, and order status.

subcommands.name: get-phone-number-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves the phone number settings for the administrator's AWS account, such as the default outbound calling name.

subcommands.name: get-retention-settings
subcommands.description: Gets the retention settings for the specified Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: get-room
subcommands.description: Retrieves room details, such as the room name, for a room in an Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: get-user
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for the specified user ID, such as primary email address, license type,and personal meeting PIN.

subcommands.name: get-user-settings
subcommands.description: Retrieves settings for the specified user ID, such as any associated phone number settings.

subcommands.name: invite-users
subcommands.description: Sends email to a maximum of 50 users, inviting them to the specified Amazon Chime Team account.

subcommands.name: list-accounts
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Chime accounts under the administrator's AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-bots
subcommands.description: Lists the bots associated with the administrator's Amazon Chime Enterprise account ID.

subcommands.name: list-phone-number-orders
subcommands.description: Lists the phone number orders for the administrator's Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: list-phone-numbers
subcommands.description: Lists the phone numbers for the specified Amazon Chime account, Amazon Chime user, Amazon Chime Voice Connector, or Amazon Chime Voice Connector group.

subcommands.name: list-room-memberships
subcommands.description: Lists the membership details for the specified room in an Amazon Chime Enterprise account, such as the members' IDs, email addresses, and names.

subcommands.name: list-rooms
subcommands.description: Lists the room details for the specified Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: list-supported-phone-number-countries
subcommands.description: Lists supported phone number countries.

subcommands.name: list-users
subcommands.description: Lists the users that belong to the specified Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: logout-user
subcommands.description: Logs out the specified user from all of the devices they are currently logged into.

subcommands.name: put-events-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates an events configuration that allows a bot to receive outgoing events sent by Amazon Chime.

subcommands.name: put-retention-settings
subcommands.description: Puts retention settings for the specified Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: redact-conversation-message
subcommands.description: Redacts the specified message from the specified Amazon Chime conversation.

subcommands.name: redact-room-message
subcommands.description: Redacts the specified message from the specified Amazon Chime channel.

subcommands.name: regenerate-security-token
subcommands.description: Regenerates the security token for a bot.

subcommands.name: reset-personal-pin
subcommands.description: Resets the personal meeting PIN for the specified user on an Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: restore-phone-number
subcommands.description: Moves a phone number from the Deletion queue back into the phone number Inventory.

subcommands.name: search-available-phone-numbers
subcommands.description: Searches for phone numbers that can be ordered.

subcommands.name: update-account
subcommands.description: Updates account details for the specified Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: update-account-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the settings for the specified Amazon Chime account.

subcommands.name: update-bot
subcommands.description: Updates the status of the specified bot, such as starting or stopping the bot from running in your Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: update-global-settings
subcommands.description: Updates global settings for the administrator's AWS account, such as Amazon Chime Business Calling and Amazon Chime Voice Connector settings.

subcommands.name: update-phone-number
subcommands.description: Updates phone number details, such as product type or calling name, for the specified phone number ID.

subcommands.name: update-phone-number-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the phone number settings for the administrator's AWS account, such as the default outbound calling name.

subcommands.name: update-room
subcommands.description: Updates room details, such as the room name, for a room in an Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: update-room-membership
subcommands.description: Updates room membership details, such as the member role, for a room in an Amazon Chime Enterprise account.

subcommands.name: update-user
subcommands.description: Updates user details for a specified user ID.

subcommands.name: update-user-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the settings for the specified user, such as phone number settings.
